answer: Resist sybils with shale fault lines, one oasis, and a wander tax. Each identity locks its bond as a shale sheet in a fault block shared with peers; one cheat fractures the whole block, so N clones in one block lose about N squared bonds while a lone agent risks one. Influence flows only from the oasis, a pool that refills slowly: N clones crowded at one oasis split a single draw, gaining nothing extra. To draw, each identity must wander a route through strangers, collecting single-use stamps; a stamp used twice voids both claims. Clones buy N sheets and N routes, yet still share one oasis.
